mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. It is a peaceful, clear night here in the city, with temperatures holding steady at 70 degrees, feeling like 71. If you step outside near Verona Community Park, you will get a lovely view of the waxing crescent moon, though the International Space Station will not be visible tonight.

The City of Verona is highlighting local sustainability options, reminding residents that apartment dwellers can participate in home composting. Food waste can be dropped off at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop located at 1220 East Verona Avenue, or handled through private collection services.

For local events, Bailey's Run Vineyard will host live music on Friday, July 17th. Additionally, the Mount Horeb Art Fair is scheduled nearby for Saturday, July 18th, showcasing fine Midwest artists and crafters.

In police news, on Thursday, July 9th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way. A 16-year-old driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way after a 74-year-old woman sustained minor injuries.
Finally, the local Culver's is currently closed and will open at 10:00 AM today. The featured flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl, followed by Mint Cookie tomorrow.
